.kitchen
Kele ka halva resipi | banana halva | balehannina ya palam halva vistrit photo aur vidiyo resipi ke satha. pake kele aur gur se taiyar ek behad saral aur lokapriy paranprik dakshin bhartiy mithaee resipi. yah na keval apne svad ke lie balki lagatar bhunne se prapt naram aur spanji banavat ke lie bhi bahut lokapriy hai. yah aamtaur par tyoharon ya utsav ki davat jaise shubh avasron ke lie taiyar kiya jata hai, lekin ise sadharan rat ke khane ki mithaee ke lie taiyar karne ke lie kisi bhi karan ki aavashyakta nahin hoti hai.
